Todo.title: Todo
Todo.description: A single task containing a title, priority level, optional description, deadline, and real-time synchronization attributes.

id.description: Unique identifier of the todo, mapping directly to the Firestore document ID.

title.description: Task title, restricted to reasonable size to prevent resource exhaustion.

deadlineTime.description: Optional deadline timestamp stored as an ISO 8601 string or numeric offset for deadline reminders.

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

category.description: Category group label for organizing tasks.

reminded.description: Audit flag tracking if the upcoming deadline reminder was presented to the user.

createdAt.description: The exact Firestore server timestamp of document creation.

updatedAt.description: The exact Firestore server timestamp of the latest edit.

todos/{todoId}.description: Flat, optimized collection for user-specific todos where query logic is locked to the authenticated user's ID.
